Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Saint Matthews for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 30 (Pet Night with Santa at Oxmoor Center, Mondays and Tuesdays) through December 15, with Nutcracker Family Storytime with Louisville Ballet at St. Matthews Library (December 2), Light Up St. Matthews (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at Dave and Buster's (December 6) and Santa Cares Day (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
